articles.title: Critical Zero-Day in Palo Alto PAN-OS Exploited in the Wild
articles.hook: Attackers actively exploit a critical PAN-OS zero-day to compromise enterprise firewalls worldwide.
bullets: CVSS 10.0 flaw allows unauthenticated remote code execution
Palo Alto urges immediate patching of all affected devices
articles.why_it_matters: Thousands of internet-facing firewalls are vulnerable, putting corporate networks at immediate risk.

articles.title: Ransomware Gang 'BlackStar' Leaks 2TB of Hospital Records
articles.hook: BlackStar ransomware group publishes millions of patient records after failed negotiations.
bullets: Three US hospital chains affected across twelve states
FBI and CISA issue joint advisory on healthcare targeting
articles.why_it_matters: Healthcare remains the top ransomware target, and this breach exposes deeply sensitive patient data.

articles.title: CISA Adds Three Actively Exploited Vulnerabilities to KEV Catalog
articles.hook: Federal agencies must patch three new KEV entries within two weeks.
bullets: Flaws impact Microsoft Exchange, Fortinet, and Apache Struts
Exploitation observed by multiple nation-state threat actors
articles.why_it_matters: KEV additions trigger mandatory federal patching deadlines and signal broad exploitation campaigns.

articles.title: New 'PhantomLoader' Malware Hides in Signed Windows Drivers
articles.hook: PhantomLoader abuses legitimate driver signatures to evade endpoint detection tools.
bullets: Malware loads second-stage payload entirely in kernel memory
Researchers link campaign to financially motivated threat group
articles.why_it_matters: Signed-driver abuse undermines a core Windows trust model, making detection extremely difficult.

articles.title: ICS Advisory: Siemens SCALANCE Switches Vulnerable to Auth Bypass
articles.hook: Critical authentication bypass in Siemens industrial switches threatens OT networks.
bullets: Unauthenticated attackers can reconfigure switch settings remotely
Siemens releases firmware update addressing the vulnerability
articles.why_it_matters: Industrial control system flaws can lead to physical safety incidents in critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Google Patches Seventh Chrome Zero-Day of 2026
articles.hook: Google ships emergency Chrome update fixing actively exploited V8 vulnerability.
bullets: Type-confusion bug in V8 engine allows sandbox escape
Users urged to update Chrome to version 131.0.6778.86 immediately
articles.why_it_matters: Browser zero-days remain a primary vector for targeted espionage and drive-by download attacks.

articles.title: Major US Bank Discloses Supply-Chain Breach via Third-Party Payroll Provider
articles.hook: A leading bank reveals customer data exposure linked to a compromised payroll vendor.
bullets: Social security numbers and account details of 1.2M customers exposed
Third-party risk management failures highlighted by regulators
articles.why_it_matters: Supply-chain attacks on financial services amplify the blast radius far beyond the initial target.

articles.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-5 With Native Multimodal Reasoning
articles.hook: GPT-5 brings real-time video understanding and step-by-step scientific reasoning to ChatGPT.
bullets: New model scores 92% on graduate-level science benchmarks
Available to Plus subscribers starting next week globally
articles.why_it_matters: GPT-5 sets a new bar for AI capability and will accelerate enterprise AI adoption across industries.

articles.title: Apple Launches M5 MacBook Pro With 'Liquid Neural Engine'
articles.hook: Apple's M5 chip doubles AI inference speed with a dedicated on-chip neural accelerator.
bullets: New 16-core Neural Engine handles 40B-parameter models locally
Battery life reaches 28 hours for the 16-inch model
articles.why_it_matters: On-device AI processing reduces cloud dependency and brings powerful ML workflows to every developer.

articles.title: EU Passes Landmark AI Liability Directive Effective January 2027
articles.hook: The EU finalizes rules making AI providers legally liable for damages caused by their systems.
bullets: Providers must carry insurance for high-risk AI applications
Non-compliance penalties reach up to 6% of global annual revenue
articles.why_it_matters: This directive reshapes AI deployment economics and compliance requirements for global tech companies.

articles.title: NVIDIA Surpasses $5 Trillion Market Cap on Record AI Chip Demand
articles.hook: NVIDIA becomes the world's most valuable company as data center GPU revenue triples.
bullets: Q3 earnings beat estimates with $48B in data center revenue
Blackwell GPU architecture drives 90% of new AI cluster orders
articles.why_it_matters: NVIDIA's dominance signals that enterprise AI infrastructure spending is still accelerating sharply.

articles.title: Federal Reserve Signals Pause on Rate Cuts Amid Sticky Inflation Data
articles.hook: The Fed holds rates steady as November inflation figures come in above expectations.
bullets: Core CPI rose 0.4% month-over-month versus 0.3% forecast
Markets now price in no further cuts until at least Q2 2027
articles.why_it_matters: A prolonged rate pause affects borrowing costs, tech valuations, and startup funding conditions.

articles.title: India and UK Sign Landmark Free Trade Agreement After Three Years of Talks
articles.hook: India and the UK finalize a comprehensive trade deal covering goods, services, and digital trade.
bullets: Tariffs eliminated on 95% of bilateral goods over ten years
Digital trade chapter includes data flow and IP protections
articles.why_it_matters: The deal opens major market access for tech services and reshapes post-Brexit UK trade strategy.

articles.title: COP31 Reaches Historic Deal to Triple Global Renewable Energy by 2035
articles.hook: Nearly 200 nations agree to binding renewable energy targets at the COP31 climate summit.
bullets: Agreement includes $300B annual climate finance for developing nations
Fossil fuel phase-down language strengthened from COP28 pledge
articles.why_it_matters: Binding targets and increased financing could meaningfully accelerate the global energy transition.
